title: Every card held under the #5499 driver-memory freeze has no fireable wake condition — the anchor is `tracking` and never closes, the freeze's stated wake has no card, and the sole existing hold carries no `Restart-when:` at all
body:
Filed by the triage seat while placing four cards on hold under #5499 (#17446 · #17348 · #17301 · #17286) and discovering that the prescribed hold cannot be spelled legally.

## The three measurements, 2026-09-11T00:2xZ

| reading | value |
|---|---|
| **#5499** — the freeze anchor every held card must reference | `open`, labels **`domain:engine` · `tracking`** ⇒ a cross-card anchor that **stays open by design** |
| the sole pre-existing hold referencing it, **#14082** | carries **no `Restart-when:` line at all** |
| a card for the wake condition #5499 names (「sqlite `:memory:` replacement complete on the test surface」) | **none exists** — board search returns only #17446 (quoting it), #17343 (unrelated) and #5499 itself |

## Why that is a contradiction, not an oversight

`references/state-machine.md:15-16` makes `pm:on-hold` legal **only** with `Restart-when: closed <owner/repo>#N` **or** a one-line executable criterion — 「两种拼写之外的 hold ⛔ 不合法」.

⇒ For a card held under this freeze:

- **`Restart-when: closed #5499`** — passes H9's presence test and **can never fire**, because #5499 is `tracking` and closing it is not in anyone's plan. ⭐ This is exactly the class **#17377** documents: 「an unreachable `closed …#N` — a `tracking` anchor that stays open by design … H9 judges presence, never reachability」.
- **`Restart-when: closed #<the replacement card>`** — there is no such card.
- **no line at all** — illegal, and what #14082 actually does.

⇒ **Every legal-looking spelling is unfireable and the only fireable one does not exist.** The freeze's own batch-close disposition (「when the sqlite `:memory:` replacement is complete on the test surface, the cards hung under it are closed **not planned** as a batch」) describes a wake nothing on the board can observe.

## What triage did in the meantime, so this card is not blocking anything

The four cards were held with the **executable-criterion** spelling, keyed to #5499's own stated wake:

```
Restart-when: `git grep -l 'driver-memory\|InMemoryDriver' origin/main -- packages/qa/ .github/workflows/` returns 0
```

⚠️ Measured: it returns **6** today (`ci.yml`, `lint.yml`, `rerun-safety-nightly.yml`, three `packages/qa/dogfood/test/*`). ⇒ Legal, meaningful, and not already satisfied. ⛔ But it is a **proxy for the replacement's completion**, chosen by triage, ⛔ not a condition anyone ruled — which is why this card exists.

## The shapes (⛔ not prescribed)

1. **File the replacement card** and point every hold at it. Cleanest, and it makes `closed #N` fire — but creating a driver-retirement programme card is not triage's to invent.
2. **Amend #5499** to name its own executable wake criterion once, so every held card can quote it instead of each inventing one.
3. **Accept the executable-criterion proxy** and write it into the freeze so the four cards' spelling becomes the standard rather than one seat's choice.

⚠️ **#14082 is a live half-state** either way — an illegal hold, since 2026-08. ⛔ Not fixed here (it is `domain:engine`'s card and this seat did not read its substance), but it should be swept in with whatever answer this gets.

## Lane

Routed **`domain:engine`**: #5499 is that lane's anchor, the four held cards are its cards, and options 1 and 2 are both edits that lane owns. ⚠️ If the answer turns out to be option 3 — writing a rule about how holds are spelled — that is protocol text and re-routes to `domain:skills`.

Refs: #5499 · #14082 · #17377 · #17446 · #17348 · #17301 · #17286
